title: Half-ladder partial waves for all $n,d$ with applications to string theory
summary: Given any four-point scattering amplitude, the partial wave expansion resolves its residues into contributions from individual spin-$s$ internal particles, where each coefficient in the expansion must be non-negative due to unitarity. In this paper, we introduce a partial wave expansion tailored to "half-ladder" Feynman diagrams at generic multiplicity $n$ and spacetime dimension $d$, with scalars on the external lines and massive bosons on the internal lines.
